name: task-create-overload
precondition: The dispatch worker and its bounded queue are occupied.

expected_response.body: task <TASK_ID> was persisted but dispatch admission failed: workpool: queue is full

normalization_rules: Replace the persisted task ID with <TASK_ID>.
side_effects: The rejected subtask is persisted as failed and resumable.
Admission is not transactional across a multi-subtask task; previously accepted work is not rolled back.
